final: WITH exam_counts AS (SELECT ID, COUNT(*) as exam_count FROM Examination WHERE ID IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ID), totals AS (SELECT SUM(exam_count) as total_exams, COUNT(*) as total_groups FROM exam_counts), fractions AS (SELECT ec.ID, ec.exam_count, CAST(ec.exam_count AS FLOAT) / t.total_exams as fraction, 1.0 / t.total_groups as avg_fraction FROM exam_counts ec CROSS JOIN totals t) SELECT ID, exam_count, fraction, fraction - avg_fraction as excess FROM fractions WHERE fraction > avg_fraction ORDER BY excess DESC LIMIT 10
